source_clean_definition.text: A call is source-clean for full-call reconstruction only when every real questioner handoff is source-supported AND every management answer that would be accepted into qa_exchange.v1 has positive replayable same-revision respondent role/title support AND no incompatible same-revision role evidence exists for that respondent.
source_clean_definition.closed_role_aliases_note: CIO is deliberately excluded; CTRE tags its Chief Investment Officer as CFO and must refuse. Widening the table to absorb the three new conflicts would silently re-admit CTRE and ARRY.
source_clean_definition.why_this_is_a_restatement_not_a_new_thre: The frozen respondent amendment already ruled that incompatible explicit segment-role vs roster/title evidence is a management_identity_conflict refusal and that missing role/title support is a management_identity_insufficient refusal, and that no accepted extended respondent may have an empty role. The R2 gold's 9-call clean set contradicted that frozen law. R3 restates the law and corrects the gold to match it; it does not raise a bar.

blocker_law.why: A call may carry several independent source blockers at once. Forcing one order-dependent scalar refusal reason hides real blockers and makes the grading gate depend on evaluation order rather than on source truth.

unresolved_questioner.meaning: At least one true structural separator in the call has a questioner that is not source-resolvable under the frozen direct/explicit-full-name-proxy law. The separator still splits Q&A windows but cannot mint a canonical qa_exchange.v1 object.

management_role_conflict.meaning: At least one management respondent has explicit incompatible same-revision role evidence (declared office/title vs tagged segment role) outside the closed CEO/CFO/COO alias table.

missing_same_revision_respondent_role_su.meaning: At least one management respondent that would be accepted into qa_exchange.v1 has no positive replayable same-revision role/title support at all (blank segment role and no roster/title declaration binding that person to a role).

blocker_law.vocabulary_note: The two respondent-layer blocker names are adjudication-level labels carried forward from the R2 gold's field naming. Their maps_to_frozen_refusal_reason values bind them to the canonical runtime refusal codes frozen in TFG0_QA_RESPONDENT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_AMENDMENT_2026-08-27.md. This binding is a restatement for the implementer; it defines no new refusal code. unresolved_questioner is a questioner-layer condition and has no respondent-layer refusal code.

corrections_from_r2.finding: Beyond the already-declared ARRY and CTRE, three further calls declare an office in the intro segment that is incompatible with the role tagged on the same person's answer segments.
corrections_from_r2.partition_effect: none — BANR, LTH and HTGC were already non-clean for unresolved_questioner. D1 changes only their frozen refusal reason SET, not the clean/refusal partition.

corrections_from_r2.finding: ARQQ and FANG each have a management respondent answering inside the Q&A window with a blank segment role and no same-revision title/roster declaration binding them to any role. corrections_from_r2.partition_effect: ARQQ and FANG move from the source-clean set to the source-refusal set. Clean 9 -> 7; refusal 7 -> 9.

corrections_from_r2.finding: CTRE, LTH, BANR and HTGC each carry both unresolved_questioner and management_role_conflict. The corrected grading law records the full pre-adjudicated source-condition set per call.

discriminator_note: SCCO/2026Q2 and COF/2026Q2 also publish blank segment roles yet ARE source-clean, because those revisions carry replayable same-revision roster/title declarations binding their management respondents to roles. ARQQ and FANG do not. A method that refuses every blank segment role is exactly as wrong as one that accepts every blank segment role; the implementation must separate these two pairs on positive same-revision evidence, not on blankness.
holdout_gate: unchanged in structure: ranks 17-24 stay unopened until every corrected development gate is green and an exact implementation head is frozen; source-only holdout adjudication must be frozen before compiler output; <6/8 source-clean means INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POWER; if powered, every source-clean slot must pass; no replacement/skip/rerank and no code change after holdout unseal. The only change is that QNA_SOURCE_CLEAN now requires positive same-revision respondent role/title support, so a slot whose management respondents are untitled adjudicates non-clean rather than clean.
holdout_power_note: The corrected definition is strictly narrower than R2's, so it can only lower the holdout clean count. An INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POWER stop under the corrected definition is a legitimate scientific outcome and must not be rescued by reverting to the falsified absence-of-conflict definition.
